stable.label: matter-lab-0.4-integrated
stable.note: Matter Lab 0.4 remains the integrated baseline. 0.5 is isolated on genesis-matter-0.5 until full PR CI passes. Live GitHub.io and real iPhone Safari remain separately unverified.

added_capabilities: toy species valence limits used only as graph constraints
visible chains and branched clusters through the existing association renderer

active_objective: Independently test that Matter Lab 0.5 forms structures larger than pairs while preserving bounded topology, deterministic behavior, particle-count conservation and the 0.4 reaction-event path.
next_gate: Open a PR from genesis-matter-0.5 to main, inspect the entire GitHub Actions run and simulation test, repair failures without rewriting the stable 0.4 core, and merge only on full PASS.
invariants: ChatGPT cannot self-certify its own changes
No critical project fact may live only in chat memory
Prototype experiments do not become product without a productionization gate
Tyler is not the build system or log courier
UNKNOWN must never silently become PASS
Infrastructure must not be described as simulation capability
CI PASS does not imply live deployment PASS or iPhone PASS
Toy reaction events must not be described as validated chemistry
Toy topology valence limits must not be described as chemical valence
Particle state transformation must conserve particle count
